name: Karwendelrast
beschreibung: The Karwendelrast Youth Hostel is located in the municipality of Vomp, directly at the junction of the Inntalautobahn A12. The accommodation caters to travel groups and individual guests and offers functional, clean rooms. There is a choice of multi-bed rooms as well as private single and twin rooms. Catering services such as breakfast, half board, and packed lunches can be booked. Thanks to its location at the foot of the Karwendelgebirges, the house is an ideal starting point for hikes, and the towns of Schwaz and Innsbruck can also be reached quickly. The infrastructure is designed for arrival by car or coach, which makes the location a typical stopover. School classes and sports groups often use the hostel for multi-day stays. Facilities include a common room and an outdoor play area for children.
